footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Gyre Therapeutics: after $4.9M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 10.2% to $117M in 2025. Gross margin was 95.4%, versus 96.3% a year earlier, and operating income fell 28.9% to $11.5M, a 9.9% margin.
Net income fell 58.4% to $5.0M, or $0.02 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.0M and free cash flow −$180K, versus −$6.0M.
sources: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
